Release Notes

This release brings a number of changes to the layout engine. Most of them are small, but a few change default behavior. Read the notes below before you update, and check your configuration file for options that were renamed or removed.

New layout options include:

  • for the scrolling layout:
    • option_one
    • option_two
  • for the stacked layout:
    • option_three

See the documentation for the full list of options.
